name: IREN Childress data center campus
summary: IREN campus at Childress in the Texas Panhandle with 750 MW of planned gross power capacity on a 576-acre freehold site, connected to the ERCOT grid through IREN-owned on-site substations. It hosts IREN's liquid-cooled Horizon AI cloud buildings, which serve Microsoft under a five-year contract of about $9.7 billion announced in November 2025. Horizon 1, a 50 MW (IT) deployment of NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems, was delivered to and accepted by Microsoft in August 2026; Horizon 2 was in commissioning and Horizons 3 and 4 in late-stage construction, with delivery targeted for the fourth quarter of 2026.
